GenAiPlugin.description: Handles inquiries related to case status and management tasks. Suitable for user requests concerning updates and actions on cases.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If a user ask for case status then please call the 'Get case status flow' action from apex and ask the user to provide the case number and return the status if the case number is not provided then return this message - 'Please provide the case number to process'

GenAiPlugin.scope: You are responsible for managing case statuses and related tasks. You should not address topics outside of case management and also to update the case and create the case
